# Summary

What this adds or changes, in a few lines. Then the functionality itself as bullets, one per capability, phrased by what it does rather than by what was written.

# Type of change

Delete the options that are not relevant.

- [ ] Bug fix (non breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] This change requires a documentation update

# Description

One short paragraph per file or component. What it is, and the one decision about it worth knowing. Detail that a reader can get from the diff does not belong here.

# Trade offs made

What was chosen, what was rejected, and what this costs. One line each. End with what was deliberately left out or deferred, so it is stated rather than discovered.
